hair_outter.role: Main hairstyle and character silhouette provider.
hair_outter.silhouette: Mid-length hair slightly past the shoulders with blunt, sharp-edged layered tips. Straight bangs (fringe) covering the forehead down to the eyebrows. Side-locks framing the face curve. Can be extended downwards within the original image boundaries.
hair_outter.light: Strong white 'Angel Ring' halo highlight around the crown. Sharp, glossy specular highlights on individual hair strands.
hair_outter.boundary: Overlays the forehead and sides of face_head_base. Tips rest on the cloth_collar and upper_body.

hair_inner.role: Depth provider and occlusion layer for the back of the head.
hair_inner.silhouette: Simple, flat shape wrapping the back of the neck. Less detailed edges compared to the outer layer. Can be extended downwards within the original image boundaries.
hair_inner.color: Dark Plum or muted Deep Pink. Must be 2-3 tones darker than hair_outter.
hair_inner.light: Minimal to none. Uses flat shading to emphasize depth rather than texture.
hair_inner.boundary: Fills the gap between the head base and the neck.

face_head_base_set.role: Structural foundation for the head and skin base.
face_head_base_set.silhouette: Soft V-shaped jawline. Slender, long neck with subtle collarbone definition. Small, rounded ears.
face_head_base_set.color: Extremely fair, translucent skin tone. Pale Purple/Grey-toned soft shadows under the chin and hairline.
face_head_base_set.light: Subtle peach-toned blush on cheeks with a slight glow. Fine highlights along the bridge of the nose and neck muscles.
face_head_base_set.boundary: Must maintain precise coordinates for hair and cloth_collar attachment points.

face_expression_eye_set.silhouette: Large, sparkling almond-shaped eyes with slightly upturned outer corners. Defined eyelashes and small, rounded mouth.
face_expression_eye_set.color: Pink gradient iris. Red/Dark Brown eyeliner.
face_expression_eye_set.light: Multiple sharp white circular catchlights in the upper iris. High-gloss finish.
face_expression_eye_set.boundary: Floating layer fixed to face_head_base. Must remain below hair layers.

upper_body_outfit_set.silhouette: Fitted shirt/blouse silhouette. Defined waistline and recessed area in the center chest for ribbon placement.
upper_body_outfit_set.color: Pure White fabric. Shadows in cool Light Grey or Pale Lavender.
upper_body_outfit_set.light: Soft ambient occlusion in fabric folds. Tiny specular highlights on buttons.
upper_body_outfit_set.boundary: Must align perfectly with arm_hand_set sleeves and skirt_outter waistline.

skirt_outter.role: Primary lower body design and pattern.
skirt_outter.silhouette: High-waisted pleated A-line skirt. Flared bottom, ending above the knees.
skirt_outter.color: Red base with Black and White grid patterns (Tartan/Plaid).
skirt_outter.light: Geometric shading following the pleats. Matte fabric texture with minimal shine.
skirt_outter.boundary: Connected to upper_body at the top and legs_stockings at the bottom.

skirt_inner.silhouette: Flat fill area visible through the bottom opening of the outer skirt.
skirt_inner.color: Very dark Burgundy or Charcoal Red.
skirt_inner.boundary: Prevents visual gaps between the legs and the outer skirt.

legs_stockings_pair.silhouette: Slender, elongated leg lines. Over-the-knee (thigh-high) stockings.
legs_stockings_pair.color: White stockings with pink horizontal stripe accents at the top. Skin tone matching the face.
legs_stockings_pair.light: Subtle vertical highlights on thighs and knees to create a satin-like fabric effect.
legs_stockings_pair.boundary: Starts under the skirt and terminates inside shoes_pair.

arm_hand_set.role: Articulated limb movement and finger detail.
arm_hand_set.silhouette: Slender fingers with visible joints. Separated segments for VTube-specific rigging.
arm_hand_set.color: Skin tone matching the face. Subtle pinkish tint on fingertips.
arm_hand_set.light: Soft rim lighting along the outer edges of the arms to separate from the torso.
arm_hand_set.boundary: Must match the cuff openings of the upper_body outfit.

cloth_collar.silhouette: Stiff, upright school-style collar. Symmetrical wings.
cloth_collar.light: Sharp, hard-edged shadows cast onto the neck.
cloth_collar.boundary: Physical bridge between face_head_base and upper_body.

ribbon_bow_accessory_set.silhouette: Large butterfly bow with split tail ends. Symmetrical.
ribbon_bow_accessory_set.color: Matching the skirt pattern (Red Plaid) or solid Crimson.
ribbon_bow_accessory_set.light: Specular highlights on the center knot and upper curves of the loops.
ribbon_bow_accessory_set.boundary: Attached to the center of the blouse and on top of the hair.

headband.silhouette: Narrow band across the crown with stylized animal (rabbit) ear attachments.
headband.color: White base with Pink polka dot pattern.
headband.light: Glossy plastic or fabric shine along the curvature of the band.

shoes_pair.silhouette: Classic student loafers. Rounded toe with low heel.
shoes_pair.light: High-contrast specular 'hotspots' on the leather surface.
